explainer_content.short_definition: Contemporary African pop crossover rooted in Afrobeats groove, diaspora collaboration, and melodic rhythmic ease.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Fela Kuti gives lineage context, while Burna Boy, Wizkid, Tems, Rema, and peers show the modern global-pop lane.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It moved African pop from specialist/world-music framing into mainstream pop discovery and awards conversation.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The groove is often light, circular, and melodic, making rhythm feel conversational rather than bluntly percussive.

Love, Damini - Burna Boy anchors Afrobeats / African Pop Crossover by making percussion and bass dialogue and dance movement built into form easier to hear.
Made in Lagos - Wizkid anchors Afrobeats / African Pop Crossover by making dance movement built into form and global pop polish around local idioms easier to hear.
Essence - Wizkid featuring Tems anchors Afrobeats / African Pop Crossover by making global pop polish around local idioms and regional rhythm as identity easier to hear.
Zombie - Fela Kuti anchors Afrobeats / African Pop Crossover by making regional rhythm as identity and language-switching or chant hooks easier to hear.
